outcome: Sleep-wake cycle composition (percentage of active sleep and quiet sleep)
finding: A well-developed sleep-wake cycle is evident immediately after birth, dominated by active sleep, and influenced by mode of delivery, with infants delivered by elective caesarean section having longer active sleep and shorter quiet sleep compared to infants delivered vaginally or by emergency caesarean section.
mod_finding: Infants delivered by elective caesarean section had longer active sleep and shorter quiet sleep compared to infants delivered vaginally or by emergency caesarean section.
